bio: Tenso the Fixer is the adopted son of Kingpin Tatsulow, and he has been the old Baron’s solid right hand for most of his life. His loyalty is absolute – even when everyone else abandoned Tatsulow, Tenso remained steadfast. Tenso is trusted without question to do Tatsulow’s work – dirty or clean.
